name: Buschtrottel Agro
summary: DIY 6 mm Depron, 900 mm. Low wing with struts, full-span ailerons, black canopy, low tailplane. 8x4.5 three-blade prop. Fixed LE slats. AT2308 1450Kv, 3S 1350 mAh, ~450 g.

notes.units: Units: metres, kilograms, newtons, seconds; angles in degrees where the name ends in 'Deg'. 'tuning' holds built-in changes in the Tuning tab's terms (paste an Export's "tuning" here).
notes.about: Low wing with V-struts to the upper fuselage, full-span ailerons, black canopy block, low tailplane.
notes.throws: Full-span ailerons are already powerful; the big plan tailplane needs less elevator throw.
notes.cgDrop: CG 3 cm lower in the airframe than the high-wing versions (m).
notes.colors: Orange and white: top third of the fuselage, tail and wing tops orange; lower fuselage and wing undersides white; sky-blue ailerons.
